31792-XV.s: This bill amends the 2008 budget statements of the Ministry of Social Affairs and Employment, adjusting appropriations and expenditure across policy articles and the baten-lastendiensten (agency) budget following the autumn budget review. It sets the amended figures in thousands of euros and provides for entry into force on 1 December of the budget year, with retroactive effect if published later.
q: We Beatrix, by the grace of God, Queen of the Netherlands, Princess of Orange-Nassau, etc. etc. etc.
Wij Beatrix, bij de gratie Gods, Koningin der Nederlanden, Prinses van Oranje-Nassau, enz. enz. enz.

31924-VIII.s: This supplementary budget act (slotwet) amends the 2008 departmental budget statements of the Ministry of Education, Culture and Science and the agency budgets for Central Financiën Instellingen and the Nationaal Archief. It records final realisation figures and the resulting budget variances per article.
q: We Beatrix, by the grace of God, Queen of the Netherlands, Princess of Orange-Nassau, etc. etc. etc. To all who shall see or hear read these presents, greetings!
Wij Beatrix, bij de gratie Gods, Koningin der Nederlanden, Prinses van Oranje-Nassau, enz. enz. enz. Allen, die deze zullen zien of horen lezen, saluut!

32187-(R1902).s: The bill approves for the whole Kingdom the Dublin Convention on Cluster Munitions of 30 May 2008, as required by Article 91(1) of the Constitution. It enters into force the day after publication in the Staatsblad.
32187-(R1902).j: The memorandum says implementing legislation similar to the Weapons and Ammunition Act and customs rules will follow, and the treaty can be accepted for the Antilles and Aruba once that is ready.
q: Once that implementing legislation is ready, the Convention can also be accepted for the Netherlands Antilles and Aruba.
Zodra die uitvoeringswetgeving gereed is zal het Verdrag ook kunnen worden aanvaard voor de Nederlandse Antillen en Aruba.

parties: Asks how the government will pursue non-party states such as the US, China and Russia and how destruction of stockpiles through NAMSA will proceed.
In what concrete way will the government work to get those countries to sign this Convention, as the Convention also requires?
Op welke manier zal de regering zich concreet inzetten om ook die landen er toe aan te zetten dit Verdrag te tekenen, zoals het Verdrag ook vraagt?
Asks whether logistical support to partners using cluster munitions is allowed, requests annual reporting on stockpiles, and questions transit of cluster munitions through Dutch territory.
The PvdA members find it undesirable to give third parties the opportunity to store cluster munitions on Dutch territory after the eight-year transition period.
De leden van de PvdA-fractie vinden het onwenselijk om derden mogelijkheden te verschaffen clustermunitie op Nederlands grondgebied op te slaan, na de overgangsperiode van acht jaar.

Presses for a ban on transit and transfer, clearer definitions, verification of destruction, and a limit on retained stocks, and objects to interoperability that could legitimise cluster munition use by non-parties.
These members ask the government to prohibit any form of transit of cluster munitions through the Netherlands and its waters, unless it is for destruction or training.
De leden van de SP-fractie vragen de regering elke vorm van doorvoer van clustermunitie door Nederland en haar wateren te verbieden, tenzij het voor destructie of training daartoe is.
Asks about the effects of entry into force on transit through Dutch territory, the retention of stocks for training, and how the government will pursue universal application of the treaty.
The ChristenUnie members ask the government what consequences entry into force of the Convention has for transit of cluster munitions through Dutch territory.
De leden van de fractie van de ChristenUnie vragen de regering welke gevolgen de inwerkingtreding van het Verdrag heeft voor de doorvoer van clustermunitie over Nederlands grondgebied.

v.summary: The Raad van State supports the Convention on Cluster Munitions but advises the explanatory memorandum to state when the implementing legislation needed for the Netherlands Antilles and Aruba will be ready, or otherwise the consequences of its absence for the Kingdom. The government's reply states that the memorandum has been supplemented under the heading Kingdom position as advised.
concerns: The Council advises stating in the explanatory memorandum when the implementing legislation for the Netherlands Antilles and Aruba is expected, or the consequences if it is not ready, and the government added this to the Kingdom position section.

32395-XV.s: The bill amends the 2010 budget statutes of the Ministry of Social Affairs and Employment (departmental budget and the operating-cost budget for agencies), changing commitments and expenditure figures for several articles in thousands of euros. It sets the amendment to take effect on 1 June 2010, with retroactive effect if the Staatsblad is published later.
q: The departmental budget statute of the Ministry of Social Affairs and Employment (XV) for the year 2010 is amended, as shown in the statement accompanying this law.
De departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid (XV) voor het jaar 2010 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

32535-(R1923).s: This bill approves the 2006 Maritime Labour Convention for the whole Kingdom of the Netherlands, giving it force of law after parliamentary consent. The explanatory memorandum describes how the convention requires adjustments to national rules on seafarers' working conditions, social security, inspection and certification, to be implemented mainly through amendments to existing statutes and ministerial regulations.
32535-(R1923).j: The memorandum justifies the convention's implementation by the need to modernise international maritime labour standards and by ratification obligations, with inspection powers to be set in the Zeevaartbemanningswet and ministerial regulations.
q: A party must, when regulating seafarers' working and rest hours, take into account the danger of (over)fatigue in relation to navigation safety and safe ship operation.

Een partij moet bij de regulering van de arbeids- en rusttijden van zeevarenden, in verband met de veiligheid van de navigatie en de veilige bedrijfsvoering op het schip, rekening houden met het gevaar van (over)vermoeidheid van zeevarenden.

parties: Asks about the costs of adapting national law and of new inspection obligations, and why each country chose its own enforcement system rather than a uniform one.
In addition, a considerable expansion of the supervisory instruments must take place.
Daarnaast dient er een aanzienlijke uitbreiding van het toezichtsinstrumentarium plaats te vinden.

Supports the convention's goals but presses the government on legal certainty, avoiding misuse and overburdening the judiciary, and on whether a ministerial regulation rather than a general administrative order should define exclusions.
to increase legal certainty and prevent misuse and unnecessary burden on the judiciary?
ter vergroting van de rechtszekerheid en ter voorkoming van misbruik en onnodige belasting van de rechterlijke macht?
Welcomes the convention but asks how supervision is organised, how it relates to European law, and whether all seafarers are adequately covered.
Op welke wijze wordt het toezicht vormgegeven?

v.summary: The Raad van State van het Koninkrijk supports the draft Kingdom act approving the Maritime Labour Convention 2006 but advises promoting co-application in all Kingdom countries and explaining the implementing legislation in the explanatory memorandum, including consequences of constitutional reform. The government's reply explains that the Netherlands Antilles will reconsider co-application, Aruba has reaffirmed non-application, and co-application will be put to Curaçao and Sint Maarten after reform, with the BES islands to be considered later.
concerns: The Raad advises promoting co-application of the MLC in all Kingdom countries, which the government partly accepts by committing to reconsider with the Netherlands Antilles and put the question to successor countries, while Aruba maintains non-application.
The Raad asks that the explanatory memorandum address the implementing legislation and the consequences of constitutional reform, which the government addresses in the amended memorandum.
The Raad notes that the Leiden report on co-application for the Netherlands Antilles and Aruba was not discussed in the explanatory memorandum, which the government's reply addresses only indirectly.

32710-XIV.s: This is a supplementary budget bill (second suppletoire begroting) amending the 2010 departmental budget of the Ministry of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality and several agency budgets, plus a slotwet closing the 2010 accounts. It also transfers accountability for the ministry's budget to the Minister of Economic Affairs, Agriculture and Innovation from 14 October 2010.
q: For the year 2010, from 14 October 2010 the Minister of Economic Affairs, Agriculture and Innovation is responsible for managing the budget of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality.

Voor het jaar 2010 geldt dat vanaf 14 oktober 2010 Onze Minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie verantwoordelijk is voor het beheer van de begroting van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit.

32710-XVI.s: This bill amends the 2010 departmental budget statute (suppletoire begroting and slotwet) of the Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport, adjusting appropriations and receipts for the policy and non-policy articles. It also amends the 2010 budget statute for the ministry's baten-lastendiensten (agencies such as the Rijksinstituut voor Volksgezondheid en Milieu and the Nederlands Vaccin Instituut) and sets the amounts in thousands of euros with retroactive effect to 31 December.
q: The departmental budget statute of the Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport (XVI) for the year 2010 is amended, as shown in the statute attached to this law.
De departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport (XVI) voor het jaar 2010 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

33201-(R1977).s: The bill tightens the conditions for acquiring Dutch nationality by requiring Dutch language proficiency and self-sufficiency through work or qualifications, lengthens decision and processing periods, and changes several grounds for refusal and loss of nationality. It also shifts some decision-making, including objections to naturalisation, from the Minister to the executive authority and extends the Minister's role in exceptional naturalisation.
33201-(R1977).j: The memorandum justifies the language and self-sufficiency rules by the need for integration and ensuring applicants can function independently, with details left to lower regulations.
q: Knowledge of the language must be sufficient to function independently on the labour market. The detailed content of this language test and how it is assessed will be set by or under an AMvB.
De kennis van de taal dient voldoende te zijn om zelfstandig te functioneren op de arbeidsmarkt. De nadere invulling van deze taaltoets en de wijze van toetsing zal bij of krachtens AMVRB geschieden.
d: I.B.3 (art. 6, lid 3 Rijkswet op het Nederlanderschap)
level of Dutch language proficiency required for naturalisation
rules on self-sufficiency and labour market qualification
p: Decisions rejecting an objection against a naturalisation decision are taken by the Minister, centralising decision power in the executive.
Exceptional naturalisation in deviation from other provisions of the law is allowed on grounds of a Kingdom interest or humanitarian circumstances, widening ministerial discretion.

parties: Asks about the required language level, the meaning of work experience, and how fraud and misuse of the qualification requirement can be prevented and verified.
What should be understood by work experience? Does this also include volunteer work and, for example, internships?
Wat moet onder werkervaring worden verstaan? Vallen hieronder ook vrijwilligerswerk en bijvoorbeeld stages?

Strongly opposes the bill on principle, arguing that loss of nationality is a very drastic measure that should only be taken on compelling grounds and that income and education thresholds are unjustified for naturalisation.
Does the government agree with the members that revoking Dutch nationality is a very far-reaching measure that may only be taken on serious grounds?
Is de regering het met deze leden eens dat het ontnemen van het Nederlanderschap een zeer ingrijpende maatregel is, die alleen om zwaarwegende gronden genomen kan worden?

Raises the European Convention on Nationality as a possible basis for distinguishing between naturalisation and retaining Dutch nationality for expats, and asks whether the distinction between option and naturalisation is still justified.
These members ask the government to explain whether the distinction between acquiring citizenship by option and by naturalisation is still justified, as this difference is becoming smaller.
Deze leden vragen de regering nader in te gaan of het onderscheid tussen het verkrijgen van het staatsburgerschap bij optie en bij naturalisatie nog gerechtvaardigd is
Questions whether the stated integration goal is supported by evidence, whether the five-year term and the nationality loss rule are proportionate, and whether the measures create new inequalities.
As far as these members are concerned, this objective is in no way substantiated.
Dit doel is wat deze leden betreft volstrekt niet onderbouwd.
Argues the bill is conservative and counterproductive, questions the evidence base, and asks about compatibility with the ECHR, the ICCPR and European case law on nationality.
These members ask the government to explain how the bill relates to Article 3 of the First Protocol to the European Convention on Human Rights.
Tevens vragen deze leden de regering aan te geven hoe het voorliggende wetsvoorstel zich verhoudt tot artikel 3 van het Eerste Protocol van het Europese Verdrag voor de Rechten van de Mens (hierna:

Asks the government to substantiate claims of reduced loyalty and integration with evidence, to assess proportionality of the renunciation requirement, to evaluate existing exceptions, and to consider the position of refugees and the ECHR.

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division (22 December 2011) advised reconsidering the broadened renunciation requirement, the extended loss grounds for Dutch nationality, the language requirement's delegation, extension of the public order check to 12-15 year olds, and extension of naturalisation waiting periods, and suggested adding an EU-law passage on the Rottman case. The government's reply (6 March 2012) largely rejected the Council's main objections on renunciation and loss grounds, while adopting the Council's drafting changes, the substantive definition of the language level in the statute, a motivated public order rationale, and an EU-law passage.
concerns: The Council questioned whether broadening the renunciation requirement is an effective means to promote integration and loyalty, and the government rejected this, saying the justification is purely legal-order based.

The Council found the necessity of broadening the loss of Dutch nationality (mirror-image loss grounds) unmotivated, and the government maintained it is necessary to avoid ineffectiveness and inconsistency.
The Council advised that the language requirement's substantive level be set in the statute rather than only delegated, and the government adopted this, with technical details left to an AMvRB.

The Council asked for motivation of the need to extend the public order check to 12-15 year olds, and the government supplemented the explanatory memorandum with examples of serious offences and the 12-year threshold from immigration law.

The Council asked for convincing justification for extending the naturalisation waiting period from three to five years for all previously exempt groups, and the government kept the change while clarifying the explanatory memorandum.
The Council advised adding a passage on the bill's place in EU free movement law in light of the Rottman judgment, and the government added it.
The Council made a redactional remark, which the government adopted along with some technical amendments.

33216-(R1980).s: The bill approves for the whole Kingdom the 2002 Protocol to the Athens Convention on carriage of passengers and luggage by sea, and attaches reservations limiting carrier and insurer liability per passenger and per ship. It also sets out that liability limits adjusted under the Protocol do not need further parliamentary approval.
33216-(R1980).j: The explanatory memorandum justifies approval of the Protocol as needed for international uniformity and because the EU and Member States share competence, without explicitly justifying the exemption from parliamentary approval for later adjustments.
q: Adjustments to the liability limits of the Protocol in Article 1, made under Article 23 of the Protocol, do not require approval by the States General.

Aanpassingen van de aansprakelijkheidsgrenzen van het in artikel 1 genoemde Protocol, tot stand gekomen overeenkomstig artikel 23 van het Protocol, behoeven niet de goedkeuring van de Staten-Generaal.
d: adjustments of liability limits under the Protocol
p: Adjustments to the liability limits of the Protocol, made under Article 23 of the Protocol, do not require approval by the States General.

v.summary: The Raad van State advises approval of the 2002 Protocol to the Athens Convention on carriage of passengers and luggage by sea, but asks that its application be extended to Curaçao, Sint Maarten and Aruba. The government's reply explains that Curaçao has for now declined co-application, while approval is sought for the whole Kingdom so co-application can follow quickly if the other countries wish.
concerns: The Afdeling asks that the Protocol also apply to Curaçao, Sint Maarten and Aruba and that implementing regulations be promoted in all Kingdom countries; the government updated the explanatory memorandum and added a passage on implementing legislation.

33440-(R1990).s: The bill amends the Passport Act to give the Dutch identity card the status of a travel document, extend validity periods for passports and identity cards, shift fee-setting for passport applications by mayors and island governors to municipal and island taxes, and stop storing fingerprints in the document administration. It also extends burgerservicenummer printing on documents and sets the minimum passport validity for minors at five years.
33440-(R1990).j: The explanatory memorandum justifies the age-18 passport validity rule by the need for reliable identification and the fee basis by constitutional requirements that taxes rest on statute.
q: The government is of the view that the ten-year validity period should not apply to passports for minors under the age of eighteen.
De regering is van opvatting dat de geldigheidsduur van tien jaar niet moet gelden ten aanzien van paspoorten voor jeugdigen tot de leeftijd van achttien jaar.
d: Artikel I, onderdeel B (art. 2, lid 3 Paspoortwet)
validity period and model of identity documents and travel documents
Artikel I, onderdeel C (art. 3, lid 2 Paspoortwet)
rules on photograph, fingerprints and signature on travel documents
Artikel I, onderdeel C (art. 3, lid 4 Paspoortwet)
cases in which burgerservicenummer is printed on travel documents
Artikel I, onderdeel D (art. 7, lid 2 Paspoortwet)
fee rates for passport handling by mayors and island governors
designation of non-EU countries where Dutch residents may receive identity cards
Minister of Foreign Affairs receives applications abroad
Artikel II, onderdeel A (art. 2, lid 3 Rijkswet 2009)
validity and territorial validity rules; deviating validity for temporary inability to take fingerprints
p: Removes the legal requirement that fingerprints be stored in the document administration beyond the application process, reducing data-protection limits on the state, though fingerprints may only be processed for issuing documents.

parties: Asks about the security risks of the electronic chip over a longer validity period, the status of the ID card after the amendment, and the reason parents' names are not included on children's passports.
That said, they also consider the physical security of these documents to be of very great importance.
Dit neemt niet weg dat zij ook de fysieke beveiliging van deze documenten van zeer groot belang vinden.

Welcomes the longer validity and the purpose limitation on fingerprints, but asks for a fast practical solution for conscientious objectors and for clarity on fingerprint destruction and the chip's vulnerability to fraud.
However, the PvdA members still have some questions they would like to put to the government.
Wel leven er bij de leden van de PvdA-fractie nog enkele vragen, die zij graag aan de regering voor willen leggen.
Asks about the added value of storing two fingerprints on the chip and the privacy and misuse risks of growing chip vulnerabilities over a ten-year validity.
Does the government not see major risks there for privacy, security and possibilities for misuse?
Ziet de regering daar geen grote risico’s voor privacy, veiligheid en mogelijkheden tot misbruik?

Welcomes reduced fingerprint collection and retention but questions whether fingerprints were really deleted from municipal databases, and asks what concrete security measures will be taken and whether fees should be set nationally.
Has this actually happened in all municipalities as well, these members wonder.
Is dit ook in alle gemeenten daadwerkelijk gebeurd, zo vragen deze leden zich af.

Asks for the abolition of municipal 'vermissingskosten' charged for lost or stolen documents, questions whether a ten-year validity is technically feasible, and asks what happens when chip security fails.
The CDA members ask the government to abolish the possibility of charging loss fees, as already promised in 2010.
De leden van de CDA-fractie vragen de regering de mogelijkheid voor het in rekening brengen van vermissingskosten af te schaffen, zoals reeds in 2010 toegezegd.

Asks why the Bekker research on biometrics is not referenced, how Article 27e of the Raad van State Act was applied given the vice-president's earlier role, and how realistic ten-year chip cryptography is, and asks for an exemption for people objecting to biometrics.
The D66 members further ask how effect has been given to Article 27e of the Council of State Act.
De leden van de D66-fractie vragen voorts op welke wijze uitvoering is gegeven aan artikel 27e van de Wet op de Raad van State
Asks whether the ten-year validity can be compared with the driving licence, what usage information is needed, and whether documents can be recalled if risks become very large.
They ask the government whether the law currently contains any possibility to recall passports and other documents in case of very large risks.
Zij vragen de regering of er op dit moment mogelijkheden zijn opgenomen in de wet om in het geval van zeer grote risico’s paspoorten en andere documenten terug te roepen.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advises reconsidering the proposed extension of passport and ID card validity from five to ten years, questions the 12-year age cut-off and the differing validity for refugee and alien travel documents, and comments on the removal of the Dutch ID card's status as a travel document and its consequences for other laws. The government's nader rapport raises the age limit to eighteen, keeps the ten-year extension, motivates the five-year limit for refugee and alien documents, and largely accepts the drafting and consequential-amendment remarks while disagreeing on the EU-law reading.
concerns: The Afdeling is not convinced that extending validity to ten years is justified given unresolved electronic security risks, and advises reconsidering; the government retains the extension with added reasoning and safeguards.
The 12-year age cut-off for the extended validity is insufficiently motivated in light of facial resemblance over time; the government raised the limit to eighteen.
The differing validity for passports of refugees and aliens with indefinite residence rights is unmotivated; the government gives a reasoned justification and keeps the five-year limit.
The Afdeling asks whether EU Regulation 2252/2004 truly requires changing the ID card's status to remove fingerprints; the government disagrees with the alternative reading.

Removing the ID card's travel-document status affects other laws referring to travel documents, such as the Wet op de identificatieplicht and fraud provisions; the government added the consequential amendments.
Editorial remarks in the annex on wording and article ordering are adopted in the bill.

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division assessed the amendment to the Passport Act extending passport withdrawal to sentences of four months or more, finding it proportionate under the right to leave a country but raising doubts about whether the Freedom of Movement Directive applies and about the motivation. The government's reply states that the explanatory memorandum has been revised as advised, that the extension is not a restriction under Article 4(1) of Directive 2004/38/EC, and that the amendment is sent to Parliament.
concerns: The Council questioned whether the withdrawal or refusal of passports constitutes a restriction under Article 4(1) of the Directive, requiring compliance with Article 27(2), and advised reviewing the motivation; the government revised the explanatory memorandum accordingly.
The Council found the amendment proportionate to the right to leave a country under the Fourth Protocol ECHR, ICCPR and EU Charter, given the public order aim.

33805-VIII.s: The bill amends the 2013 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Education, Culture and Science, adjusting expenditure, commitments and revenues across policy articles. It also allows a multi-year budget reserve for state guarantees covering residual debt of education institutions, deviating from article 5(4) of the Comptabiliteitswet 2001.
33805-VIII.j: The memorandum justifies the reserve on grounds of administrative efficiency, avoiding five separate reserves, and says a general statutory arrangement will follow in the revision of the Comptabiliteitswet.
q: Notwithstanding article 5(4) of the Comptabiliteitswet 2001, a multi-year budget reserve charged to the non-policy article Apparaatskosten (article number 95) is maintained for 2013.

In afwijking van artikel 5, vierde lid, van de Comptabiliteitswet 2001 wordt voor het jaar 2013 een meerjarige begrotingsreserve ten laste van het niet-beleidsartikel Apparaatskosten (artikelnummer 95) aangehouden.
p: Deviates from the Comptabiliteitswet 2001 to allow a multi-year budget reserve for guarantees on residual debt of education institutions, with the explanatory memorandum noting a future general statutory provision will be made.

33865-(R2024).s: The bill approves for the whole Kingdom the 2010 Kampala amendments to the Rome Statute of the International Criminal Court, which add the crime of aggression. It also amends the Dutch Nationality Act so that the crimes referenced in its article 14 include the amended provisions of the Statute.

parties: Asks how the legal justification, burden of proof and enforceability of the war crimes harmonisation would work, and asks about the timing and diplomatic effect of the aggression definition.
Please provide the government's further explanation of the legal implications, burden of proof, justification and feasibility of this agreement.
Graag een nadere toelichting van de regering op de juridische implicaties, bewijslast, motivering en de uitvoerbaarheid van deze afspraak.

Welcomes the amendments and the complete jurisdiction of the Court over aggression, but asks about the limits of jurisdiction, the threshold clause, the opt-out and the activation meeting, and urges that no obstacles be raised.
The SP members consider it important that the required thirty countries ratify the amendments quickly.](#)
Het is volgens de leden van de SP-fractie belangrijk dat snel de benodigde dertig landen de amendementen ratificeren.

Has critical notes on the aggression crime: concern about politicisation of the Court, dependence on the Security Council for determining aggression, the scope of the definition, and the risk that the crime becomes an empty shell through opt-outs.
The D66 members fear that the crime of aggression will thus become an empty shell.
De leden van de D66-fractie vrezen dat het misdrijf agressie zo een lege huls wordt.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division supports the draft Kingdom Act approving the Kampala amendments to the Rome Statute adding the crime of aggression, but asks the explanatory memorandum to address the current state of international law on exceptions to the prohibition of aggression and the differences between the amended Elements of Crimes and the 2010 resolution on dum-dum bullets. The government's reply (nader rapport) states that both points were followed by expanding the explanatory memorandum, and the drafting remark was also adopted.
concerns: The memorandum should explain the current state of international law on possible exceptions to the prohibition of aggression, such as humanitarian intervention, responsibility to protect and preemptive self-defence.
The memorandum should address the differences between the added Elements of Crimes on dum-dum bullets and the 2010 resolution's wording on intent and objective element.
The title should add 'voor de wetgeving op Koninkrijksniveau' after 'uitvoering'.

33940-VIII.s: This first supplementary budget for the Ministry of Education, Culture and Science for 2014 amends the 2014 departmental budget statement and the agency budget for DUO, shifting spending across policy articles. It also establishes a multi-year budget reserve for state guarantees on residual debts of education institutions.
33940-VIII.j: The memorandum justifies the multi-year budget reserve on administrative efficiency grounds and notes a general statutory provision will follow in a future revision of the Comptabiliteitswet.
q: From a standpoint of administrative efficiency, it is not desirable to maintain five separate budget reserves charged to the relevant policy articles.
Uit een oogpunt van administratieve doelmatigheid is het niet gewenst dat er vijf aparte begrotingsreserves worden aangehouden ten laste van de betrokken beleidsartikelen.

34356-(R2064).s: The bill amends the Dutch Nationality Act to let the Minister withdraw Dutch nationality from persons who join foreign armed forces at war with the Kingdom, or who join, in the Minister's discretion, an organisation on a published list and threaten national security. It adds a judicial remedy: a direct appeal to the Hague district court (or the Caribbean first-instance court), with the Minister obliged to file an appeal on the person's behalf if they do not.
34356-(R2064).j: The memorandum justifies the discretionary list and withdrawal power by the unpredictable rise of terrorist organisations and the need for flexibility and a single moment of weighing, and argues prior judicial review is unsuitable given the immediacy of national security protection.
q: This gives due weight, on the one hand, to the flexibility needed given the often unpredictable rise of terrorist organisations and their threat to the Dutch legal order.
Hiermee wordt enerzijds recht gedaan aan de benodigde flexibiliteit bij de vaak onvoorspelbare opkomst van terroristische organisaties en hun bedreiging voor de Nederlandse rechtsorde
d: Artikel I B, lid 4 (art. 14 lid 4 Rijkswet op het Nederlanderschap)
list of organisations involved in armed conflict used for nationality withdrawal
rules on elements of the balancing of interests in withdrawal decisions
Artikel I D, art. 22B lid 5 and art. 22C lid 2
designation of body assigning counsel and rules on implementing legal aid and fees for appointed counsel
p: The Minister may strip nationality from persons abroad whose conduct shows membership of a listed organisation, with the list itself set by the Minister in line with the Council of Ministers rather than by statute.

The Minister may withdraw nationality from a person who voluntarily joins foreign military service of a state at war with the Kingdom or its alliance, replacing automatic loss of nationality with a discretionary ministerial decision.

Judicial protection is provided by direct appeal to court without a prior objection phase, and the court may not examine the case beyond the grounds raised except through the integral review the bill provides, with secret material available only to the court.

parties: Asks what the criteria are for the list of organisations and when nationality is actually revoked, probing the scope of the executive's discretion.
Argues the measure is punitive and that the absence of prior judicial intervention and limited defence rights weaken legal protection; questions the list being set by the Minister alone.
They therefore consider that this bill, which aims to revoke nationality without first involving a judge, would only add value in a few exceptional cases.

Zij zijn dan ook van mening dat het onderhavige wetsvoorstel, dat beoogt om het Nederlanderschap in te trekken zonder eerst tussenkomst van een rechter, daarom maar in enkele uitzonderlijke gevallen een extra waarde zal kunnen hebben.
Doubts proportionality and reliability of intelligence-based revocation without criminal conviction, and how a bestuursrechter can adequately review secret information.
The question is whether intelligence information, especially from difficult-to-access areas, is always reliable enough to deprive someone of Dutch nationality.
De vraag is of de informatie van inlichtingendiensten, juist in moeilijk toegankelijke gebieden, in alle gevallen betrouwbaar genoeg is om iemand het Nederlanderschap te ontnemen.
Objects to the Minister filing appeal against his own decision ex officio, calling it a conflict with the decision and urging judicial safeguards and a clearer legal basis.
The CDA members noted with surprise the construction the government devised for the Minister to lodge an appeal ex officio against his own decision.
De leden van de CDA-fractie hebben met verbazing kennisgenomen van de constructie die de regering heeft bedacht om de Minister ambtshalve beroep in te laten stellen (tegen diens eigen beslissing).

Sees serious conflict with fundamental rights and rule of law, questioning the 'beyond reasonable doubt' standard, the effectiveness of the measure, and the loss of nationality before a judge confirms the decision.
To declare a foreigner undesirable it is necessary that this person actually is a foreigner.
Voor het ongewenst verklaren van een vreemdeling is het noodzakelijk dat deze persoon ook daadwerkelijk vreemdeling is.
Questions proportionality and irreversibility, asks for the criteria in the general administrative order to be set in law or submitted to parliament, and questions applying the measure to minors.
Because this is a far-reaching measure, these members consider it important to know in advance what those criteria are.
Omdat het hier gaat om een ingrijpende maatregel, achten deze leden het van belang om vooraf te weten wat die criteria zijn.
Asks why the government chose a discretionary power rather than a mandatory revocation, and how the ex-nationality residence status and ban interact.
These members ask, however, why the government has refrained from a mandatory provision to revoke Dutch nationality.
Deze leden vragen echter waarom de regering heeft afgezien van een dwingende bepaling om het Nederlanderschap in te trekken.
Asks why automatic loss of nationality is being replaced by a ministerial decision and whether the existing system is malfunctioning.
Are there many problems with loss by operation of law, or is that system not functioning well?
Zijn er bij het verlies van rechtswege veel problemen of functioneert dat systeem niet goed?

Concerned about implementation of the rijkswet on Sint Maarten given poor synchronisation between departments and ministries, and asks what happens to a person who becomes stateless after losing nationality.
out of concern about the implementation of this rijkswet in Sint Maarten, in particular given the lack of synchronisation between departments and ministries of the government.
uit bezorgdheid ten aanzien van de implementatie van deze rijkswet in Sint Maarten met name gelet op het gebrek aan synchronisatie tussen afdelingen en ministeries van de overheid.
Worried that nationality could be withdrawn before the suspect is actually convicted, making anyone a potential target, and asks whether the burden of withdrawal will fall on Sint Maarten.
likewise out of concern about the possibility of withdrawing Dutch nationality before the suspect has actually been convicted.
uit eveneens bezorgdheid ten aanzien van de mogelijkheid het Nederlanderschap in te trekken voordat de verdachte daadwerkelijk is veroordeeld.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised against proceeding with the bill to allow withdrawal of Dutch nationality in the interest of national security for joining a terrorist organisation, citing insufficient added value over criminal law, disproportionality given limited legal protection, and unclear EU law assessment. The government's nader rapport partly accepted the advice, amending the explanatory memorandum, the EU law framing, the individual interest balancing (to be set by AMvB), and the wording on voluntariness, but rejected the call to restrict the measure's scope and to extend the special remedy regime to military service withdrawals.
concerns: The Afdeling is not convinced the measure adds value over existing criminal law powers, and the explanatory memorandum does not adequately justify this.

The Afdeling is not convinced the severe measure is proportionate given limited legal protection for the person abroad; the government considers the restriction necessary and proportionate and adds clarifications.
Limited ability of the person abroad to participate in proceedings conflicts with the principle of hearing and counter-hearing; the government maintains the restriction is justified.
The explanatory memorandum must address the EU law framework (Rottmann proportionality test and Directive 2004/38), which the government adds.

Concern that withdrawal may cause counterproductive radicalisation and loss of prosecutorial powers; government disputes the loss of criminal jurisdiction and addresses radicalisation through case-by-case assessment.
Definition of joining a terrorist organisation must be clarified in the statute, combining intent and acts; the government amends the wording.
Legal basis for ongewenstverklaring of a person abroad is questioned; the government points to the legislator's intent and the 2003 amendment.
Individual interest balancing factors should be specified, with key elements set by AMvB; the government adopts this.
Special remedy regime should also apply to withdrawal for foreign military service; the government declines, citing the possibility of temporary access for court proceedings.

34550-XIII.s: This bill formally establishes the 2017 departmental budget statements for the Ministry of Economic Affairs, the budget statements for agencies (baten-lastenagentschappen), and the budget for the Animal Health Fund (Diergezondheidsfonds). It sets amounts in thousands of euros and provides for entry into force on 1 January 2017 with retroactive effect where publication is later.
q: The departmental budget statement for the year 2017 attached to this law is hereby established.
De bij deze wet behorende departementale begrotingsstaat voor het jaar 2017 wordt vastgesteld.

34730-XIII.s: This bill amends the 2017 budget statutes for the Ministry of Economic Affairs, its executive agencies, and the Animal Health Fund through a first supplementary budget. It adjusts appropriations, revenues and agency figures and sets an entry-into-force rule with retroactive effect to 1 June 2017.
q: The departmental budget statement for the year 2017 is amended, as shown in the corresponding statement attached to this law.
De departementale begrotingsstaat voor het jaar 2017 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

34775-XII.s: This bill fixes the 2018 departmental budget (begrotingsstaat) of the Ministry of Infrastructure and Environment and the budgets of its agencies, in thousands of euros. It sets the entry into force of the budget law and sets out the policy articles and their financial instruments, including how much spending is legally committed.
q: Article 1: The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Infrastructure and Environment for the year 2018 belonging to this law is established.
Artikel 1 De bij deze wet behorende departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Infrastructuur en Milieu voor het jaar 2018 wordt vastgesteld.

34960-XV.s: The bill amends the 2018 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Social Affairs and Employment, adjusting expenditure and revenue figures in line with the spring memorandum. It sets the amounts in thousands of euros and fixes entry into force as of 1 June 2018.
q: Amendment of the budget statements of the Ministry of Social Affairs and Employment (XV) for 2018 (amendment linked to the Spring Memorandum)
Wijziging van de begrotingsstaten van het Ministerie van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid (XV) voor het jaar 2018 (wijziging samenhangende met de Voorjaarsnota)

35095-XV.s: The bill amends the 2018 departmental budget of the Ministry of Social Affairs and Employment (XV), changing both expenditure and commitments by article in thousands of euros, in line with the autumn budget memorandum. It sets the effective date as 1 December 2018 or the day after publication, with retroactive effect where publication falls later.
35095-XV.j: The memorandum justifies the budget amendment by reference to realisation data and forecasts for 2018 (underspending on subsidies, contributions and benefit entitlements), not by any new executive power.
q: Based on realisation data for 2018, a total underspending of EUR 6.5 million is expected.
Op basis van realisatiegegevens over 2018 wordt er een totale onder uitputting van –/– € 6,500 miljoen verwacht.

35187-(R2124).s: The bill amends the Dutch Patent Act 1995 to implement the Unified Patent Court agreement and EU regulation 1257/2012 on unitary patent protection, redefining patent rights, exceptions and the jurisdiction of the Hague court. It also extends the Hague district court's exclusive jurisdiction over enforcement claims and provides transitional and overseas-territory rules for European patents with unitary effect.
35187-(R2124).j: The memorandum justifies the single delegation by the need to align the Dutch Patent Act with the Unified Patent Court agreement and EU regulation, with further rules left to a general administrative order.
q: By general administrative order, further rules may be laid down concerning the provisions of article 54c, subsection j.
Bij algemene maatregel van rijksbestuur kunnen nadere regels worden gesteld ten aanzien van het bepaalde in artikel 54c, onderdeel j.
d: further rules on the exemption for farmers' use of livestock

parties: Has no further questions on the bill.
These members have no further questions at this time.
Deze leden hebben hierbij geen verdere vragen.

Asks the government to clarify the scope of the Unified Patent Court exemptions, the financing of translation cost reimbursement, and the legal meaning of unitary patents as property, while asking about the EPO's social situation.
The CDA members ask what the decompilation exemption in the Unified Patent Court agreement entails.
De leden van de CDA-fractie vragen wat de decompilatievrijstelling uit het Rechtspraakverdrag inhoudt.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised proceeding with the bill amending the Rijksoctrooiwet 1995 for the Unified Patent Court and European patent with unitary effect, but asked that the explanatory memorandum clarify the scope of 'offering' a patented process under article 53, and align its discussion of Article 112 of the Constitution with the advice on the Court agreement. The minister's reply (nader rapport) largely accepts these points, clarifying the cross-border offering rule, trimming the constitutional discussion, and adjusting several provisions and the Caribbean territories' position.
concerns: The explanatory memorandum gave two inconsistent interpretations of 'aanbieden' (offering) in article 53, which risks uncertainty about the scope of patent protection; the government clarified that offering from abroad aimed at infringing acts in the Kingdom is an infringement.

The explanatory memorandum's discussion of the constitutional aspects of the Court agreement under Article 112 of the Constitution should be brought in line with the Afdeling's advice on the Court agreement bill; the government removed the substantive discussion from this memorandum.

Redactional remark that the commentary should follow the order of the Court agreement's articles rather than the bill's; the government did not adopt this but added article titles indicating the corresponding Rijksoctrooiwet provision.

35450-XIII.s: This first supplementary budget for 2020 amends the departmental budget of the Ministry of Economic Affairs and Climate and the budgets of its executive agencies, raising spending appropriations by about EUR 5.3 million and shifting funds between articles. It sets the effective date to the day after publication, with retroactive effect to 1 May 2020.
q: This budget is increased by EUR 5.3 million.
Dit budget wordt verhoogd met € 5,3 mln.

35470-VIII.s: This bill (Slotwet 2019) amends the 2019 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Education, Culture and Science and the 2019 budget statements of the agencies DUO and Nationaal Archief, setting realised figures and final budget differences. It contains no delegation of rule-making power, and its only operative provisions fix the amounts in thousands of euros and the entry into force.
q: We ... have resolved and decided ... The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Education, Culture and Science (VIII) for 2019 is amended
Wij Willem-Alexander ... hebben goedgevonden en verstaan ... De departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap (VIII) voor het jaar 2019 wordt gewijzigd

35650-VIII.s: The bill amends the 2020 budget statements of the Ministry of Education, Culture and Science and the DUO agency (second supplementary budget), shifting spending and receipts across articles in thousands of euros. The explanatory memorandum describes budgetary mutations, mainly technical transfers and changes to programmes such as teacher recruitment and student finance, with no new delegation or power over institutions.
q: The budget is reduced on balance by EUR 135.0 million.
Het budget wordt per saldo met € 135,0 miljoen verlaagd.

35830-VIII.s: This slotwet (closing budget act) adjusts the 2020 departmental budget of the Ministry of Education, Culture and Science and the budgets of the agencies DUO and the Nationaal Archief, in thousands of euros. It sets out the realised figures and the resulting budget differences per article and provides for entry into force retroactively to 31 December 2020.
q: The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Education, Culture and Science (VIII) for the year 2020 is amended, as shown in the statement attached to this act.
De departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap (VIII) voor het jaar 2020 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

36350-XIII.s: This first supplementary budget amends the 2023 departmental budget of the Ministry of Economic Affairs and Climate and the budgets of its executive agencies, shifting several billion euros between policy articles such as energy, Groningen and the national growth fund. It sets the budget in thousands of euros and makes the law effective the day after publication, retroactive to 1 June 2023.
q: The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Economic Affairs and Climate (XIII) for the year 2023 is amended, as shown in the statement attached to this law.
De departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Economische Zaken en Klimaat (XIII) voor het jaar 2023 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

36351-(R2184).s: The bill amends the Dutch-Curaçao tax arrangement (BRNC) to implement BEPS outcomes, adding rules on transparent investment entities, pension funds, anti-treaty-shopping (principal purpose test), dividends, interest and permanent establishment-related provisions, and deleting several articles. It also sets entry into force and application dates, with a five-year review clause for the investment fund treatment.
36351-(R2184).j: The memorandum justifies the changes as implementing OECD BEPS outcomes and preventing double taxation and tax avoidance, and provides for evaluation of the investment fund treatment after at most five years.
q: obtaining that benefit was one of the principal purposes of an arrangement or transaction that resulted directly or indirectly in that benefit
het verkrijgen van dit voordeel een van de voornaamste redenen was voor een constructie of transactie die direct of indirect tot dat voordeel heeft geleid
p: A principal-purpose anti-abuse test lets competent authorities refuse treaty benefits on broad factual judgement, with a consultation duty between the two countries before refusal.
Mutual agreement procedure is opened to either competent authority and the timing of referral is tied to the availability of information, giving authorities more discretion over taxpayer procedures.

parties: Asks why the bill departs from drafting guidelines, why the Council of State's criticism of the preamble is not addressed, and how the Council of State's objections are met.
The VVD members further ask the government to reflect on why it does not substantively address the valid criticism of the Council of State's advisory division.

De leden van de VVD-fractie vragen de regering voorts te reflecteren op waarom zij niet inhoudelijk ingaat op het terechte punt van kritiek van de Afdeling advisering van de Raad van State van het Koninkrijk.
Asks for explanation of why budgetary effects are neutral for both the Netherlands and Curaçao and whether the new treaty affects business tax burdens.
The D66 members request the government to further explain why the expected budgetary effects are neutral.
De leden van de D66-fractie verzoeken de regering nader toe te lichten waarom de verwachte budgettaire effecten neutraal zijn.
Worries that the anti-abuse test is opaque and that special arrangements could undermine minimum tax rates, asking for transparency and democratic oversight of tax treaty dispute procedures.
These members also ask the government to explain exactly what the phrase 'valid commercial reasons reflecting economic reality' means.
Deze leden vragen de regering bovendien uit te leggen wat de zinsnede «geldige zakelijke overwegingen die de economische realiteit weerspiegelen» precies inhoudt.
Supports the bill as a means to restore the financial sector and jobs, while seeking confirmation that a Dutch-law concept does not apply to Curaçao partnerships.
With this amendment of the Tax Arrangement Netherlands Curaçao, the mistakes of the past must be repaired.
Met deze wijziging van de Belastingregeling Nederland Curaçao moeten de fouten van het verleden hersteld worden.

Asks many questions about the impact, negotiations, participants and whether the bill respects the equality principle and the Statute's rijksnorm; requests a proper procedure and analysis of benefits.
It is important that the procedure for adopting this national law is carefully followed and that the law is also in accordance with the equality principle.
Het is van belang dat de procedure voor het vaststellen van deze rijkswet zorgvuldig wordt gevolgd en dat de rijkswet ook in overeenstemming is met het gelijkheidsbeginsel.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on a draft Kingdom Act amending the Belastingregeling Nederland Curaçao to implement OECD BEPS outcomes, raising a major objection to changing the considerans and several technical points on definitions, source rules and double taxation relief. The Staatssecretaris's nader rapport largely accepted the advice: it justified the considerans change, clarified the vorderingen and pensioenfonds wording, and aligned Article 4 with the OECD model, while the double-taxation provision was removed because of a new Curaçao decree.
concerns: The Afdeling advised deleting the amendment to the considerans of the BRNC because it will not be visible on wetten.nl, or else motivating it; the government kept it but added a justification in the explanatory memorandum.
The explanatory notes on the term 'vorderingen' in Article 1(4) were unclear and needed clarification.

The definition of 'pensioenfonds' in Article 3(1)(j) needed clarity that all four criteria apply cumulatively also under paragraph 5; the government reworded the provision rather than aligning it with the OECD model text.
The sentence added to Article 4(1) deviated from the OECD Model Tax Convention and should be aligned with it.
The phrase 'dan wel is gelijk aan' in Article 21(7) was unclear; the provision was removed after publication of the Curaçao double taxation decree.

36550-VIII.s: The bill amends the 2024 departmental budget of the Ministry of Education, Culture and Science and the 2024 budget of the agency DUO by approving first supplementary budget figures in thousands of euros, with retroactive effect to 15 April 2024. It is a budgetary appropriation law that reallocates spending across education, culture and research articles without delegating rule-making or decision power.
q: The adoption of the budget statements takes place in thousands of euros.
De vaststelling van de begrotingsstaten geschiedt in duizenden euro’s.

36613-VIII.s: The bill amends the 2024 budget statement of the Ministry of Education, Culture and Science (VIII) by adjusting appropriations and expenditure across several policy articles, as set out in the attached tables. It is a supplementary budget bill whose changes take effect from 17 September 2024, with retroactive effect where publication is later.
q: The budget statement of the Ministry of Education, Culture and Science (VIII) for the year 2024 is amended, as shown in the statement attached to this law.
De begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap (VIII) voor het jaar 2024 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

36625-XV.s: This bill amends the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Social Affairs and Employment for the year 2024 through a second supplementary budget, adjusting expenditure and receipt figures across policy articles. The memorandum sets out the budget changes by article without creating new delegations or powers for the executive.
q: Amendment of the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Social Affairs and Employment for the year 2024
Wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid voor het jaar 2024

36800-XIII.s: This is the 2026 budget bill for the Ministry of Economic Affairs, setting departmental expenditure and receipts (tables 1-3 of the budget schedules) and the budgets of three baten-lastenagentschappen (DICTU, RVO, RDI) in thousands of euros. The explanatory memorandum describes policy priorities, subsidy and guarantee programmes and budgetary flexibility, without creating new delegated rule-making or shifting powers away from parliament or the courts.
q: Adopted departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Economic Affairs (XIII) for the year 2026
Vastgestelde departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Economische Zaken (XIII) voor het jaar 2026

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State issued a blanket opinion with no remarks on the 2026 budget bill for the Ministry of Economic Affairs (XIII) and advised submission to the Tweede Kamer. The minister's nader rapport accompanies the opinion and notes that some budgets require amendments, which are set out in annexes.

36820-VIII.s: This bill amends the 2025 budget schedule (departementale begrotingsstaat) of the Ministry of Education, Culture and Science, adjusting authorised commitments, expenditure and receipts per budget article and taking effect from 16 September 2025. The explanatory memorandum shows the budgetary effects on Article 4 (vocational and adult education), including a reduction in commitments, a small expenditure cut and a transfer to the NRO research body.
q: The budget schedule of the Ministry of Education, Culture and Science (VIII) for the year 2025 is amended, as shown in the schedule attached to this law.
De begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap (VIII) voor het jaar 2025 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

36850-XV.s: This second supplementary budget amends the 2025 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Social Affairs and Employment, mainly by downward adjustments to the childcare allowance, the Zwanger en zelfstandigen-regeling and the TSB/TAS schemes, and an upward adjustment to the Ziektewet. The bill itself contains no delegation of rule-making power and only sets the budget amounts and entry into force.
36850-XV.j: The memorandum justifies the budget changes by reference to lower-than-expected claims and uitvoeringsinformatie from the SVB and UWV, not by any claim to new powers.
q: Based on implementation information from the UWV, the expenditure on the Ziektewet (ZW) has been adjusted upward by a net € 107.5 million for 2025.
Op basis van uitvoeringsinformatie van het UWV zijn de uitgaven aan de Ziektewet (ZW) per saldo met € 107,5 miljoen opwaarts bijgesteld voor 2025.
